diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index 1cb1494..189e1f4 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -491,6 +491,37 @@ class TestWebEngineArgs:
         args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)
         assert ('--enable-experimental-web-platform-features' in args) == has_arg
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('qt_version, is_qt6, mode, expected', [
+        ('5.15.2', False, 'auto', False),
+        ('6.5.3', True, 'auto', True),
+        ('6.6.0', True, 'auto', False),
+        ('6.5.3', True, 'always', True),
+        ('6.6.0', True, 'always', True),
+        ('6.5.3', True, 'never', False),
+        ('6.6.0', True, 'never', False),
+    ])
+    def test_accelerated_2d_canvas(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser,
+                                   version_patcher, qt_version, is_qt6, mode,
+                                   expected):
+        version_patcher(qt_version)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(machinery, 'IS_QT6', is_qt6)
+        config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas = mode
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parser.parse_args([]))
+        assert ('--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas' in args) == expected
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('chromium_major', [None, 0, 110, 111])
+    def test_accelerated_2d_canvas_auto_chromium_boundary(
+            self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser, chromium_major):
+        versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('6.5.3')
+        versions.chromium_major = chromium_major
+        monkeypatch.setattr(machinery, 'IS_QT6', True)
+        config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas = 'auto'
+
+        args = list(qtargs._qtwebengine_settings_args(
+            versions, parser.parse_args([]), []))
+        assert ('--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas' in args) == (chromium_major == 110)
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize("version, expected", [
         ('5.15.2', False),
         ('5.15.9', False),
